summary: @grammasheri All the #clmooc blogs will be built together once I get an OPML files and build out a planet. The @hypothes_is layer is a just a quick and dirty social layer to put on top using a tool in a way it was never meant to be.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @grammasheri All the #clmooc blogs will be built together once I get an OPML files and build out a planet. The @hypothes_is layer is a just a quick and dirty social layer to put on top using a tool in a way it was never meant to be.
